name: prompt-provenance-fleet-summary-action
description: GitHub Action that walks a directory of prompt-provenance docs, counts by approval state, surfaces governance gaps (approved-without-evaluations, approved-without-reviewer, evaluation-failing-on-approved, deprecated-still-referenced), posts a Markdown summary as a PR comment, and fails the build when high-severity findings exist. Wraps prompt-provenance-fleet-summary; sibling of agent-card-fleet-summary-action + mcp-tool-card-fleet-summary-action.
author: mizcausevic-dev
